title: Vikram and the Vampire: Classic Hindu Tales of Adventure, Magic, and Romance
sourceTitle: Vikram and the Vampire: Classic Hindu Tales of Adventure, Magic, and Romance
author: Burton, Richard Francis, Sir
description: "Vikram and the Vampire: Classic Hindu Tales of Adventure, Magic, and Romance" is a collection of tales originally written in Sanskrit, with recensions dating to the 11th century.
longDescription: The work follows legendary King Vikramāditya as he attempts to capture a vetala—a vampire spirit inhabiting dead bodies and hanging from a tree.

authorInfo.bio: Burton, Richard Francis, Sir (1821–1890) wrote Vikram and the Vampire: Classic Hindu Tales of Adventure, Magic, and Romance. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
